experiment: Image-level multi-label item classifier; its scores are added (max after neg-z scaling) to E1 dense scores for Lighter and Bullet

train.selection: val mean image AP over 12 items

data: train for weights, val for epoch selection; calib and test splits are only scored after training

combine.norm: per model and item: z = (logit(score) - mean) / sd of calib negatives, then sigmoid; only items that mix models

arms.E1+cls: Lighter and Bullet: max of E1 dense and classifier after neg-z; other 10 items E1
arms.E1<-cls: reference only: Lighter and Bullet replaced by classifier scores

gate.setting: F, cap 5%, delta 0.05/36, seeds 0-9, arm E1+cls

also_report: image AP per item on easy, hard, hidden
second network doubles inference per image
deadline: decide by 2026-11-19; reject and record if the gate is not met
caveat: The gate reads the repeatedly used PIDray test set, so a pass is exploratory and not independent validation. Thresholds in this file are fixed before training and are not changed after seeing results.
